title: Maths
blurb: Every area of maths in one place, from fractions to linear algebra, matching Brilliant's maths paths. Each course is built in full before you open it.

folders.title: Foundational maths
folders.blurb: The building blocks, from fractions to the first ideas of algebra and geometry.

courses.title: Fractions
courses.blurb: What a fraction really is, and how to add, compare and divide them.

courses.title: Negative numbers
courses.blurb: Numbers below zero, and why minus times minus is plus.

courses.title: Percentages
courses.blurb: Percentages as hundredths: finding them, raising and cutting by them, and percentage change.

courses.title: Proportional reasoning
courses.blurb: Ratios, rates and scaling: when doubling one thing doubles another, and when it halves it.

courses.title: Solving equations
courses.blurb: Finding an unknown by keeping both sides level, then rearranging the formulas you use at work.

courses.title: The coordinate plane
courses.blurb: Placing points on a grid, choosing scales, and reading values off graphs and curves.

courses.title: Geometry fundamentals
courses.blurb: Area, circles, square units, Pythagoras and volume, from cable sizes to tank litres.

folders.title: Algebra
folders.blurb: Algebra for the HNC: from straight lines to complex numbers, in the order the college and calculus need.

courses.title: Linear equations
courses.blurb: Expressions with an unknown, and the moves that solve them.

courses.title: Straight-line graphs
courses.blurb: y = mx + c: slope and intercepts, the distance between points, and fitting a line to data.
courses.from: Brilliant: Coordinate Geometry and Linear Relationships

courses.title: Linear systems
courses.blurb: Two straight lines, two equations, and where they meet: simultaneous equations, as Kirchhoff’s laws need them.

courses.title: Powers and roots
courses.blurb: Fractional and negative powers, roots and the rules that tie them together, with powers of ten and units.

courses.title: Functions and their graphs
courses.blurb: A function as a machine: inputs, outputs and their graphs, and how shifting or stretching a graph changes its rule.
courses.from: Brilliant: Introduction to Functions and Coordinate Transformations

courses.title: Quadratics and polynomials
courses.blurb: Parabolas, factorising and the quadratic formula, then curves built from higher powers.

courses.title: Exponentials and logarithms
courses.blurb: Growth that multiplies, the number e, and the logarithm that undoes it: capacitor charging, decibels and pVⁿ = C when n = 1.
courses.from: Brilliant: Exponentials and Logarithms, and Logarithms

courses.title: Trigonometry
courses.blurb: Sine, cosine and tangent, from triangles to waves: AC, phasors and conduit bends.

courses.title: Complex numbers
courses.blurb: The square root of minus one and the plane it opens up: j-notation phasors in polar form, as AC circuits are written.
courses.from: Brilliant: Complex Numbers and Polar Coordinate Plane

folders.title: Advanced maths
folders.blurb: Calculus, vectors and linear algebra, as taught from sixth form into university.

courses.title: Calculus fundamentals
courses.blurb: Derivatives and integrals properly: rules, meaning and uses.

courses.title: Vectors
courses.blurb: Quantities with a size and a direction, and how to combine them.

courses.title: Matrices
courses.blurb: Grids of numbers that move, stretch and turn whole shapes at once.

courses.title: Linear algebra
courses.blurb: Vector spaces, determinants, eigenvalues and what they reveal.

courses.title: Vector calculus
courses.blurb: Calculus on fields, all the way to Maxwell's equations.

courses.title: Differential equations
courses.blurb: Equations about change, and how to solve and read them.

folders.title: Probability, statistics and data
folders.blurb: Chance, evidence and data: how to reason when things are uncertain.

courses.title: Statistics for engineers
courses.blurb: Measurements, trends and reliability: how far to trust a reading, whether a drift is wear or noise, and how often equipment fails.

courses.title: Descriptive statistics
courses.blurb: Averages, spread and what a set of numbers is really saying.

courses.title: Data visualisation
courses.blurb: Charts that tell the truth, and how charts mislead.

courses.title: Probability fundamentals
courses.blurb: Counting outcomes, and the rules that chances follow.

courses.title: Conditional probability
courses.blurb: How the chance of one thing changes when you know another.

courses.title: Expected value
courses.blurb: The long-run average of a gamble, a bet or a decision.

courses.title: Regression and prediction
courses.blurb: Fitting a line to data, and how far to trust it.

courses.title: Bayesian reasoning
courses.blurb: Updating what you believe as new evidence arrives.

folders.title: Logical reasoning
folders.blurb: Clear thinking: deduction, puzzles and the logic inside every circuit.

courses.title: Logic
courses.blurb: Deduction: what must follow from what you know.

courses.title: Truth and lies
courses.blurb: Puzzles about people who always lie or always tell the truth.

courses.title: Reasoning with logic
courses.blurb: Statements, conditions and building a sound argument.

courses.title: Digital circuits
courses.blurb: Logic gates, and how switches add up to a computer.

folders.title: Everyday maths
folders.blurb: Maths as it turns up in real life: bills, odds, measurements and the news.

courses.title: Everyday statistics
courses.blurb: Averages, surveys and the numbers in the news, read with a clear head.

courses.title: Probability and chance
courses.blurb: Odds, luck and risk in games, bets and everyday choices.

courses.title: Geometry and measurement
courses.blurb: Lengths, areas, volumes and angles, as used on a real job.

courses.title: Real-world algebra
courses.blurb: Letters standing for quantities, for working out bills, mixes and plans.

folders.title: Mind-Bending Math, puzzles and enrichment
folders.blurb: Maths for the fun of it: puzzles, contest problems and where it all came from.

courses.title: 100 days of puzzles
courses.blurb: A hundred short puzzles, one a day, from easy to fiendish.

courses.title: Strategy puzzles
courses.blurb: Games and puzzles where the winning move can be worked out.

courses.title: Maths puzzles
courses.blurb: Classic puzzles, and the clever ideas that crack them.

courses.title: Infinity
courses.blurb: Sizes of infinity, endless sums and the paradoxes they raise.

courses.title: Number theory
courses.blurb: Primes, divisibility and the hidden patterns in whole numbers.

courses.title: Geometric thinking
courses.blurb: Seeing the answer in a shape: angles, areas and clever constructions.

courses.title: Contest maths
courses.blurb: Competition problems, and the strategies to solve them.

courses.title: The history of maths
courses.blurb: How the big ideas were discovered, and by whom.
